verdict.rationale: Retell's docs describe drag-and-drop, node-based conversation flows as one of its agent types, and a Transfer Call tool routes calls to a human with cold, warm and agentic warm modes. Conductor can also edit a conversation flow in plain language. The visual builder itself is documented only in a single line, and branching logic, state handling and in-flow handoff nodes are implied by "node-based" rather than spelled out. missing for 10: explicit documentation of branching or conditional edges in the flow builder, state or node semantics, handoff nodes within flows, independent or hands-on corroboration of the visual builder.

support.subject: As a founder, I can design multi-step conversation flows in a visual builder with branching, states, and handoffs without writing code

citations.quote: Drag-and-drop, node-based flows for structured, high-stakes calls.
Retell agents are node-based flows or single prompts, with call handling, a knowledge base, and integrations built in.
Ask Conductor to change your agent's prompts, settings, or conversation flow in plain language.
route calls to a human, with cold, warm, and agentic warm transfer modes
